nav.info_modal_description: Processing Community Day (PCD) is a worldwide series of community-led events celebrating art, code, and open-source creative tools. Events are organized by local communities around the globe.
nav.info_modal_forum_btn_new_tab: Visit the forum thread (opens in new tab)
nav.submit_modal_step1_body: Create a forum account, learn more about PCD, and connect with other organizers.
nav.submit_modal_step2_body: Start a discussion for your city, country, or region on the forum.
nav.submit_modal_step3_heading: Add your event to the map
nav.submit_modal_step3_body: Fill in the GitHub form. Your event will appear here shortly.
nav.submit_modal_recommendation_pre: We encourage you to host your PCD event
nav.submit_modal_note: No GitHub account? Just say hi in the forum thread and we'll help you from there.
